entry.title: Ferdowsi Mausoleum
entry.note: The complete mapped platform and four asymmetric stair flights are authored in the exact footprint frame. The southern (+Z) face receives the winged figure described by the national cultural source; native dimensions are preserved. The wider western stair and the three narrower flights retain their mapped widths and offsets. Garden pools, separate statues and museum buildings are separate map scenery. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
